CLASS 34 · AGES 4–5 · 29 WEATHER LESSONS

Weather, Seasons & What We Wear.

HOW THIS CLASS WORKS

Read the sky, then dress for it.

Every topic in this class has its own step-by-step lesson: look at the picture together, learn what the weather or the garment really is, say the parent script, ask the questions, play the practice game and finish with a small understanding check. The order is gentle: the sun and clouds first, then the weather words, then the day-kinds — sunny, rainy, stormy, snowy, foggy — then the temperatures, the four seasons, and finally the clothes that match every kind of sky.

The best part of this class is that the weather marks your homework. After the sunny-day lesson, a sunny day arrives for free practice; after the raincoat lesson, so does the rain. One topic a day is plenty — the whole class is a month of five-minute sessions, wherever your child’s curiosity points.

WEATHER SAFETY, AGE-HONEST

Small people, real weather.

Weather safety is built into the lessons where it belongs: never staring at the sun, hats and water in the heat, staying inside for storms, penguin steps on ice, bright colours in fog, scarf ends tucked in for climbing. Every rule is phrased for four-year-old bodies and honest about feelings — no scare tactics, no fake promises, just routines that hold.

Solve the Weather & Seasons worksheets.

Each sheet has a printable twin in the worksheet library.
